okcook — Privacy Policy

Last updated: 15 August 2026 · applies to okcook v1.0.2

okcook is a browser extension that reads a recipe from a page you are looking at and turns

it into ingredients, steps and a shopping list. This policy describes exactly what it does

with data, and it is written to be accurate rather than reassuring — the Chrome Web Store

treats an inaccurate privacy disclosure as a policy violation, and so do we.

What stays on your device

Your meal plan, saved recipes, pantry items, shopping-list check-offs and display settings

are stored locally in your browser using chrome.storage.local. They never leave your

device. okcook has:

  • no user accounts and no sign-in
  • no analytics, telemetry, crash reporting or advertising
  • no third-party SDKs of any kind
  • no server that holds your recipes, meal plan, pantry or settings

Uninstalling the extension removes all of it.

What leaves your device, and only when you ask

1. The recipe page you asked okcook to read.

When you open okcook on a recipe page, the page is read locally in your browser and nothing

is transmitted. When you instead paste a recipe URL into the Meal Planner, okcook fetches

that URL so it can extract the recipe. That request goes to the recipe website itself, not

to us. We do not receive it, log it or store it.

2. Feedback you choose to send.

The "Send feedback" form is the only feature that sends anything to us. Pressing send submits

the report to a Google Form owned by the okcook developer. It is never sent automatically, and

never without you pressing the button.

What the report contains — all of it typed or chosen by you, or read from your own browser:

  • the summary and description you typed
  • the feedback type and impact you selected
  • your email address, only if you choose to enter it — it is optional, and its only use

is so we can reply to you

  • the extension version, and your browser name and version
  • the page address, if you started the report from okcook's "Report this page" link on a

page it couldn't read

That is the whole report. okcook does not attach an identifier of any kind, and there is no

account or device ID to attach. If you leave the email field blank, we have no way to know who

sent it.

okcook does not collect your IP address. An earlier version of this form ran through a

server that logged IP addresses to rate-limit abuse; that server is gone, and so is that

collection.

Where it goes. Into a private response sheet that only the okcook developer can read.

Google acts as the processor, since it operates Forms —

as with any website, Google's own servers see the request that delivers your report, under

Google's privacy policy. Reports are not published, and are not posted to any public tracker.

How long it's kept. For as long as the response sheet exists. Ask us to delete a report

and we will.

If you never use the form, okcook sends nothing to us, ever.

What okcook never does

  • It does not collect or transmit your browsing history.
  • It does not read pages you have not asked it to process. The content script that ships

with okcook registers a message listener and then does nothing until you invoke the

extension on that page.

  • It does not sell or transfer your data to third parties.
  • It does not use your data for advertising, credit assessment, lending, or any purpose

unrelated to the feature you invoked.

  • It does not load or execute any remote code. Every script runs from the installed package.

Permissions and why they exist

storage — keeps your meal plan, recipe book, pantry and settings on your device.

Host permission <all_urls> — okcook cannot know in advance which recipe site you will

use, so it cannot list them. The permission is used for two things only: reading the recipe

on a page you have open when you invoke the extension, and fetching a recipe page when you

paste its URL into the Meal Planner.

Children

okcook is not directed at children and does not knowingly collect data from anyone.

Changes

Material changes to this policy will be published here and reflected in the extension's

store listing before they take effect.

Contact

Use the extension's built-in feedback form, or email okcook.feedback@gmail.com.
